purpose: Automatically detect AES changes, verify the sealed normative source, refresh the content pin and run Uter conformance gates.

checks.name: AES seal and fingerprint
checks.rule: Execute the AES-owned governed-fingerprint verifier with --require-intact; invalid or missing seal is BLOCKED.

checks.name: Registry and pin integrity
checks.rule: Recompute registry blob SHA, registry version, governed fingerprint and all fingerprint components; refresh stale pin only when the seal is intact.

checks.name: Requirement applicability
checks.rule: Resolve every applicable P00-P12 requirement and UTER-P13 requirement into the machine traceability inventory.

checks.name: Project conformance
checks.rule: Run requirement-level implementation, executable verification and evidence checks; no registry pin or sync event can promote conformance.

checks.name: Overlay and duplicate analysis
checks.rule: Compare local AI specifications against AES requirements; retire exact duplicates only after semantic parity and zero-reference checks; preserve Uter-specific overlays.

checks.name: Autonomous remediation
checks.rule: Execute safe, reversible repository remediation; automatically deny production, real-funds, destructive and out-of-scope operations.

checks.name: Independent re-verification
checks.rule: Rerun affected tests, security checks, quality gates, business invariants and evidence integrity after each remediation.

hard_constraints: The AES content pin identifies normative rule content only and never implies Uter product conformance.
integration_status can become INTEGRATED only when the complete requirement-level conformance engine derives CONFORMANT from current evidence.
Do not create branches, push, merge, create pull requests or deploy.
Preserve pre-existing tracked and untracked changes.
Automatically deny production database writes, real payment operations, production credentials and irreversible side effects.
Do not convert FAIL, BLOCKED, NOT_RUN, UNKNOWN or NOT_VERIFIED into PASS.
